_comment: Phase 1 regression baseline for the Pump Hydraulics module (app.js runActualPumpCalculations). Captured from the live app on 2026-09-04, immediately after fixing the pump-eff-override id typo in applyPumpCorrection('efficiency') — that fix does not touch this calculation path, so these expected values are the pre-existing, already-validated behaviour, not a new answer being asserted for the first time. If a future phase changes app.js and one of these numbers moves, that is a deliberate change to review, not something to silently update this file to match.

cases.name: clean-water-atmospheric-to-pressurized
cases.description: Water, atmospheric suction tank elevated above grade, discharging up and into a pressurized vessel. All 12 standards checks pass.

cases.name: cavitation-risk-hot-suction-lift
cases.description: Hot water (80C), pump mounted 4m above a near-empty atmospheric tank -> suction lift + high vapour pressure. Deliberately unsafe: the NPSH margin check and overall cavitation verdict must FAIL.
